verses.shown: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
verses.context:
Psalms 42:1 For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
   Psalms 42:2 My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
>> Psalms 42:3 My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
   Psalms 42:4 These things come to mind as I pour out my soul: how I walked with the multitude, leading the procession to the house of God with shouts of joy and praise.
   Psalms 42:5 Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.

verses.context:
>> John 14:1 “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God; believe in Me as well.
   John 14:2 In My Father’s house are many rooms. If it were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
   John 14:3 And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and welcome you into My presence, so that you also may be where I am.

verses.shown: You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
verses.context:
Hebrews 10:34 You sympathized with those in prison and joyfully accepted the confiscation of your property, knowing that you yourselves had a better and permanent possession.
   Hebrews 10:35 So do not throw away your confidence; it holds a great reward.
>> Hebrews 10:36 You need to persevere, so that after you have done the will of God, you will receive what He has promised.
   Hebrews 10:37 For, “In just a little while, He who is coming will come and will not delay.
   Hebrews 10:38 But My righteous one will live by faith; and if he shrinks back, I will take no pleasure in him.”
